entries.name: Graphify
entries.description: Codebase and docs knowledge graph for coding agents, built locally with tree-sitter, served via skills, hooks and MCP.
entries.license: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE) with LICENSE-MIT also present; confirm which applies
entries.agent_os_overlap: orchestrator/repomap.py already gives planners a repo map; memory and handoff layers overlap the memory half.

useful_parts.always_on_instruction_plus_graph_report: pre-read summary file referenced from the instruction file

entries.integration: none planned; would be a worker-side skill/MCP install

risks.scope: very large surface beyond code maps

evidence.runtime_savings: unmeasured here; README says 80% fewer tokens, repo harness measures coverage not tokens
evidence.quality: author harness: 82.0% vs 70.8% key-fact coverage on 6 ERPNext questions, unreplicated
evidence.security: local parsing; docs semantic pass sends content to a model backend
evidence.complexity: high, hundreds of modules and many ingestors

entries.rationale: Code-context benefit is shown only on 6 author-chosen questions, it duplicates our repomap, and it adds a large dependency that writes into the target repo.
provenance: web search roundups and reviews (2026-10-17); no r/OpenSourceAI thread found
revisit_when: an independent benchmark shows lower exploration cost or higher task success
planner or worker context misses cause repeated FAILs

entries.name: repo-map
entries.description: MCP server with a tree-sitter symbol graph, PageRank importance and symbol-level read tools for Python and JS/TS.
entries.agent_os_overlap: overlaps orchestrator/repomap.py and the PA-aider ranking idea; adds symbol-scoped reads.

useful_parts.get_symbol: read one body instead of a file

evidence.runtime_savings: claims -33% workflow tokens on one unpublished workflow; our results are already narrowed so likely lower
evidence.security: local only, cache in home directory
evidence.complexity: moderate, single server plus tree-sitter deps

entries.rationale: Savings figure comes from one unpublished workflow; test the symbol-vs-file read replay before building anything.
provenance: no independent coverage or r/OpenSourceAI thread found
revisit_when: replay shows whole-file reads over 10% of tool-result bytes

entries.name: RepoMapper
entries.description: CLI and MCP server port of Aider's repo map: tree-sitter tags, personalized PageRank, token-budget fitting.
entries.agent_os_overlap: Same technique as the PA-aider BORROW entry; orchestrator/repomap.py is the Agent OS counterpart.

useful_parts.personalized_pagerank_with_budget_search: rank toward goal files then binary-search the map size to a token budget

entries.integration: none; reimplement with ast in repomap.py if ever needed

risks.provenance: LLM-written from a spec, no tests

entries.rationale: Stale, untested and non-stdlib as a dependency; the PageRank idea stays tracked under PA-aider.
revisit_when: planner context misses cause repeated FAILs and PA-aider ranking is pursued

entries.name: agentless-mcp
entries.description: Model-free tree-sitter repo map, symbol lookup, patch parsing, lint, validation and equivalence-clustered voting; CLI plus read-only MCP server.
entries.agent_os_overlap: Its lint/validate/vote mirror our deterministic validators and retry handling; the tool-order hook acts on the worker CLI.

useful_parts.lint_diff: complexity, contract-drift and clone deltas on a diff against its base
useful_parts.equivalence_clustering: collapse byte-identical candidate results before voting
useful_parts.tool_order_gate: defer broad grep until a symbol-map call

entries.integration: call the CLI from a validator step; optional worker hook config

risks.grammar_download: fetches a digest-verified grammar bundle unless disabled

evidence.development_savings: small to moderate if lint replaces hand-written checks
evidence.runtime_savings: unmeasured on our workload; possible retry reduction
evidence.quality: SWE-Explore-Bench n=60 Sonnet: restricted-tool arm beat free choice on six localization metrics, CIs exclude 0 (author-run)
evidence.security: local, no model; hooks read Bash commands
evidence.portability: CLI works from any agent; MCP read-only

entries.rationale: Only project here with a published paired benchmark and a deterministic, callable lint/validate side; localization gain still needs showing on our tasks.
provenance: Glama listing used to locate the repo
revisit_when: lint --diff test flags at least 20% of validator-failing diffs with under 10% false positives
an independent replication of the benchmark appears

entries.name: code-review-graph
entries.description: Local tree-sitter/SQLite code graph with blast-radius and risk-scored change analysis served over MCP for code review.
entries.agent_os_overlap: Independent reviewers check diffs; blast-radius context (callers, dependents, tests) is what they currently grep for.

useful_parts.blast_radius: changed symbols to callers, dependents and tests

entries.integration: stdlib ast/grep approximation feeding reviewer prompts; not the graph store

risks.baseline: headline compares against feeding the whole corpus
risks.surface: 30 tools, installer rewrites hooks and instruction files

evidence.runtime_savings: claims 65x on flask against whole-corpus baseline; not comparable to a grep-narrowing agent
evidence.quality: repo has impact_accuracy and agent_baseline benchmarks, author-run
evidence.reliability: over 100 test modules, CI on four Python versions
evidence.complexity: high for the full tool; low for the concept

entries.rationale: Take the blast-radius idea for reviewer context; the 65x headline uses a baseline no real agent uses, so skip the graph store.
provenance: web search listings; no r/OpenSourceAI thread found
revisit_when: reviewer misses are traced to unseen callers or tests
the offline blast-radius replay shows at least a quarter of valid findings outside the diff
